categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang HangKe Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, R&D, manufacturing, and sales of lithium-ion battery post-processing systems, including charging and discharging equipment, testing devices, logistics equipment, and supporting software systems. The company provides integrated solutions for lithium battery production lines, serving major domestic and international lithium battery manufacturers. It also operates subsidiaries globally to support overseas markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as digital power supply, high-frequency PWM conversion, automatic calibration, high-temperature pressurized formation, and energy recovery. It develops proprietary systems like the 4680 charging and discharging system, new generation control systems, and 750V-5V high-voltage DC bus power modules. Integration of MES, logistics scheduling, intelligent warehousing, AI deep learning, and 3D digital management enhances its intelligent manufacturing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium-ion battery manufacturers such as SK, LG, Samsung, Sony (Murata), BYD, CATL, EVE Energy, Guoxuan High-Tech, Sunwoda, Envision Power, and Lishen. The company serves markets in consumer electronics, automotive power batteries, and energy storage sectors, providing equipment critical for battery formation, capacity grading, and testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries in Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Poland, the United States, Germany, Hungary, and other regions. It actively expands in Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, aligning with global lithium battery production capacity expansions.
categories.supply_chain_position: HangKe Technology operates in the midstream to downstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, specializing in post-processing equipment for lithium-ion battery manufacturing lines. It provides integrated systems that are essential for battery formation, testing, and quality assurance after cell production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent manufacturing, digital control systems, and energy-efficient technologies. It invests heavily in R&D to develop next-generation equipment for emerging battery technologies such as solid-state batteries and large-format cylindrical cells (4680). Strategic focus includes expanding overseas production capabilities, enhancing automation, and integrating AI and digital twin technologies for predictive maintenance and process optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized lithium-ion battery production equipment, including charging/discharging machines and testing devices. The company also provides related software and integrated solutions, with revenue recognized upon delivery, installation, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HangKe Technology is positioned as a leading global supplier of lithium battery post-processing equipment, competing with major domestic and international equipment manufacturers. It maintains strong partnerships with top-tier battery producers and is one of the few Chinese companies capable of exporting complete equipment sets and collaborating closely with Japanese and Korean battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.93 billion, a 13.83% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 809 million, up 64.92%. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding overseas orders and improved gross margins. Total assets reached over RMB 10.2 billion, reflecting significant scale and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HangKe Technology emphasizes high-precision, energy-efficient, and intelligent lithium battery post-processing equipment with strong customization capabilities. Its products feature advanced digital control, rapid response protection, flexible structural design, and integration of AI and digital twin technologies. The company offers comprehensive solutions that improve battery quality, safety, and manufacturing efficiency, differentiating itself through technological leadership and global service capabilities.
